description.en: The identity of the application group.

description.zh: 请求体，包含凭据类型等信息。
description.en: The request body, which contains information such as the credential type.

description.zh: 指定此次操作是否为 dry run，即只检查参数，不实际执行操作。
description.en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run. In a dry run, the system checks the request parameters but does not execute the operation.
